title: ALMA 大型毫米及次毫米波陣列
subcategoryTitle: 大型望遠鏡與重力波觀測站
summary: 從查南托高原的大氣透射出發，建立 ALMA 以 54 座 12 m 與 12 座 7 m 天線、最長 16 km 基線在 0.32–3.6 mm 波段合成孔徑的工程鏈：天線面形與 Ruze 效率、4 K SIS 前端、183 GHz 水汽輻射計相位校正、校正誤差預算、相關器資料流與陣列驗收。
summaryEn: Starting from atmospheric transmission on the Chajnantor plateau, this course builds the engineering chain by which ALMA synthesises an aperture from 54 twelve-metre and 12 seven-metre antennas on baselines up to 16 km at 0.32–3.6 mm: surface accuracy and Ruze efficiency, 4 K SIS front ends, 183 GHz water-vapour-radiometer phase correction, calibration error budgets, correlator data flow and array acceptance.
scope: 依公開物理原理與官方資料編寫的原創教學；步驟是可驗證的學習任務與假想算例，不是原廠配方、施工圖、設備操作許可或安全程序。數值均為教學假設，需依實際規格重算。
scopeEn: Original teaching built from public physics and official sources. Steps are verifiable learning tasks and hypothetical exercises, not vendor recipes, construction drawings, operating authorisation or safety procedures. Numbers are teaching assumptions and must be recalculated for real specifications.

stages.title: 系統邊界與物理原理
stages.description: 本階段聚焦「高原站址與毫米波大氣不透明度」與「干涉成像、角解析度與可回復尺度」：先建立機制與定量模型，再設計驗證並診斷失效。
stages.descriptionEn: This stage covers "High site and millimetre-wave atmospheric opacity" and "Interferometric imaging, angular resolution and recoverable scales": build the mechanism and quantitative model first, then design verification and diagnose failures.

steps.title: 高原站址與毫米波大氣不透明度：原理與系統邊界
steps.titleEn: High site and millimetre-wave atmospheric opacity: mechanism and system boundary
steps.objective: 說明「查南托高原大氣視窗」如何決定ALMA 大型毫米及次毫米波陣列的關鍵性能，並畫出其輸入、輸出與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Chajnantor atmospheric window” determines the key performance of “Atacama Large Millimeter/submillimeter Array”, and map its inputs, outputs and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 毫米與次毫米波段的主要吸收體是大氣水汽，其壓力增寬的轉動譜線在 183 GHz、325 GHz 等處形成強吸收帶，帶間才是可觀測的大氣視窗。ALMA 選址在海拔約 5000 m 的查南托高原，可沉降水汽（PWV）中位數約 1 mm，使 0.32–3.6 mm（35–950 GHz）十個接收波段都有可用的透射率。大氣不只吸收訊號，也以自身溫度發射雜訊，因此站址同時決定訊號損失與系統雜訊的下限；這是整個陣列的第一道系統邊界。 師傅任務：以方塊圖畫出能量或訊號通過「查南托高原大氣視窗」的路徑，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由環境或製造決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: At millimetre and submillimetre wavelengths the dominant absorber is atmospheric water vapour, whose pressure-broadened rotational lines near 183 GHz and 325 GHz form strong absorption bands; the gaps between them are the observable windows. ALMA sits on the Chajnantor plateau at about 5000 m, where the median precipitable water vapour (PWV) is near 1 mm, so all ten receiver bands between 0.32 and 3.6 mm (35–950 GHz) have usable transmission. The atmosphere not only attenuates the signal but radiates noise at its own temperature, so the site fixes both the signal loss and the noise floor; it is the first system boundary of the array. Mentor task: draw a block diagram of the energy or signal path through “Chajnantor atmospheric window”, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by environment or fabrication, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：天頂不透明度 τ₀ 時，仰角對應大氣質量 A 的透射率為 exp(−τ₀·A)，天空亮溫 T_sky ≈ T_atm·[1 − exp(−τ₀·A)]。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: With zenith opacity τ₀, the transmission at airmass A is exp(−τ₀·A) and the sky brightness is T_sky ≈ T_atm·[1 − exp(−τ₀·A)].
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「只要天線夠大，站址高度對毫米波觀測影響不大。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在方塊圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "With big enough antennas, site altitude hardly matters at millimetre wavelengths." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your block diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 方塊圖標明「查南托高原大氣視窗」的輸入、輸出與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The block diagram shows inputs, outputs and boundaries of “Chajnantor atmospheric window”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.text: 誤解：只要天線夠大，站址高度對毫米波觀測影響不大。 正確的工程判斷必須回到機制與量級。

knowledge.title: 任務延伸｜遊戲交班延伸：先界定介面
knowledge.titleEn: Mission extension | Campaign transfer: define interfaces first
knowledge.text:
本課「ALMA 大型毫米及次毫米波陣列」的「高原站址與毫米波大氣不透明度：原理與系統邊界」是這項延伸任務的檢核點。 畫出試件、激發、光路或訊號路徑與讀出的邊界，在每條箭頭旁寫量、單位、正方向與資料版本。再打開「觀測站：找回微弱訊號」，比較哪一個介面可類比、哪一個不可類比；不可因為畫面相似就共用數值參數。

需留下的證據：提交一張介面圖與校正件識別、暗場或零點、原始訊號與取樣設定的欄位樣本；將假設值、來源值與本次實測值分欄。

驗證與交接：每個介面至少有一個可核對量；提出一項能讓模型失效的邊界改變，而不是只重述公式。
knowledge.textEn:
The checkpoint is “High site and millimetre-wave atmospheric opacity: mechanism and system boundary” in “Atacama Large Millimeter/submillimeter Array”. Draw the specimen, excitation, optical/signal path and readout boundaries; label quantities, units, sign conventions and data revisions on each arrow. Open “Observatory: Recover a Faint Signal” and identify which interfaces transfer and which do not. Similar-looking scenes do not justify shared numerical parameters.

Evidence to retain: Submit an interface diagram and sample fields for reference-artifact identity, dark/zero records, raw signals and sampling settings, separating assumed, sourced and newly measured values.

Verification and handover: Each interface has a checkable quantity. Identify one boundary change that invalidates the model instead of merely repeating a formula.

quiz.question: 關於「高原站址與毫米波大氣不透明度」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "High site and millimetre-wave atmospheric opacity" is correct?
options: 只要天線夠大，站址高度對毫米波觀測影響不大。
毫米與次毫米波段的主要吸收體是大氣水汽，其壓力增寬的轉動譜線在 183 GHz、325 GHz 等處形成強吸收帶，帶間才是可觀測的大氣視窗。
基線越長影像品質一定越好，短基線只是備用。
optionsEn: With big enough antennas, site altitude hardly matters at millimetre wavelengths.
At millimetre and submillimetre wavelengths the dominant absorber is atmospheric water vapour, whose pressure-broadened rotational lines near 183 GHz and 325 GHz form strong absorption bands.
Longer baselines always give better images; short baselines are just backup.
quiz.explanation: 毫米與次毫米波段的主要吸收體是大氣水汽，其壓力增寬的轉動譜線在 183 GHz、325 GHz 等處形成強吸收帶，帶間才是可觀測的大氣視窗。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: At millimetre and submillimetre wavelengths the dominant absorber is atmospheric water vapour, whose pressure-broadened rotational lines near 183 GHz and 325 GHz form strong absorption bands; the gaps between them are the observable windows. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 高原站址與毫米波大氣不透明度：定量估算
steps.titleEn: High site and millimetre-wave atmospheric opacity: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「查南托高原大氣視窗」的關鍵量，並判斷參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Chajnantor atmospheric window” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of changes when a parameter moves.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：天頂不透明度 τ₀ 時，仰角對應大氣質量 A 的透射率為 exp(−τ₀·A)，天空亮溫 T_sky ≈ T_atm·[1 − exp(−τ₀·A)]。取 345 GHz、PWV = 1 mm 時 τ₀ ≈ 0.15（教學假設）、T_atm = 260 K：天頂透射率 exp(−0.15) = 0.861、T_sky ≈ 36 K；仰角 30°（A = 2）時透射率 0.741、T_sky ≈ 67 K。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: With zenith opacity τ₀, the transmission at airmass A is exp(−τ₀·A) and the sky brightness is T_sky ≈ T_atm·[1 − exp(−τ₀·A)]. Taking τ₀ ≈ 0.15 at 345 GHz for PWV = 1 mm (teaching assumption) and T_atm = 260 K: zenith transmission exp(−0.15) = 0.861 with T_sky ≈ 36 K; at 30° elevation (A = 2) transmission is 0.741 and T_sky ≈ 67 K. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, and state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper.
steps.observation: 如何核對：以站址的 183 GHz 水汽輻射計或 225 GHz 傾斜輻射計做天空傾角掃描（sky dip），在數個仰角量天空亮溫並擬合 τ₀；再把擬合值與公開的大氣透射模型（例如 ALMA 所用的 ATM 模型）在同一 PWV 下的預測比較，差異應在 10% 以內，否則檢查輻射計增益校正。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Perform a sky dip with the site 183 GHz water-vapour radiometer or a 225 GHz tipping radiometer, measuring sky brightness at several elevations and fitting τ₀; then compare the fitted value with a public atmospheric transmission model (such as the ATM model ALMA uses) at the same PWV.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成設備規格，或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit conversion slips, treating teaching assumptions as equipment specifications, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 重現模型中的數值（取整誤差在 ±5% 內），並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與物理解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values (within ±5% rounding) and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with a physical explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: 天頂不透明度 τ₀ 時，仰角對應大氣質量 A 的透射率為 exp(−τ₀·A)，天空亮溫 T_sky ≈ T_atm·[1 − exp(−τ₀·A)]。取 345 GHz、PWV = 1 mm 時 τ₀ ≈ 0.15（教學假設）、T_atm = 260 K：天頂透射率 exp(−0.15) = 0.861、T_sky ≈ 36 K；仰角 30°（A = 2）時透射率 0.741、T_sky ≈ 67 K。
knowledge.textEn: With zenith opacity τ₀, the transmission at airmass A is exp(−τ₀·A) and the sky brightness is T_sky ≈ T_atm·[1 − exp(−τ₀·A)]. Taking τ₀ ≈ 0.15 at 345 GHz for PWV = 1 mm (teaching assumption) and T_atm = 260 K: zenith transmission exp(−0.15) = 0.861 with T_sky ≈ 36 K; at 30° elevation (A = 2) transmission is 0.741 and T_sky ≈ 67 K.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設；套用到實際設備前，必須重新取得規格、操作條件與不確定度。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions; before applying them to real equipment, obtain the actual specifications, operating conditions and uncertainties.

quiz.question: 依「高原站址與毫米波大氣不透明度」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "High site and millimetre-wave atmospheric opacity", which statement holds?
options: 接收機冷到 4 K 之後，系統溫度就只剩天空的貢獻。
流量校正用的行星是理想點源，不需要模型。
天頂不透明度 τ₀ 時，仰角對應大氣質量 A 的透射率為 exp(−τ₀·A)，天空亮溫 T_sky ≈ T_atm·[1 − exp(−τ₀·A)]。
optionsEn: Once the receiver is at 4 K, the system temperature is only the sky's contribution.
Planets used for flux calibration are ideal point sources and need no model.
With zenith opacity τ₀, the transmission at airmass A is exp(−τ₀·A) and the sky brightness is T_sky ≈ T_atm·[1 − exp(−τ₀·A)].
quiz.explanation: 天頂不透明度 τ₀ 時，仰角對應大氣質量 A 的透射率為 exp(−τ₀·A)，天空亮溫 T_sky ≈ T_atm·[1 − exp(−τ₀·A)]。 重算時請保留單位。
quiz.explanationEn: With zenith opacity τ₀, the transmission at airmass A is exp(−τ₀·A) and the sky brightness is T_sky ≈ T_atm·[1 − exp(−τ₀·A)]. Keep units when recalculating.

steps.title: 高原站址與毫米波大氣不透明度：量測與驗證
steps.titleEn: High site and millimetre-wave atmospheric opacity: measurement and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的量測，驗證「查南托高原大氣視窗」是否符合模型預期，並訂出允收準則。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable measurement that verifies whether “Chajnantor atmospheric window” meets the model expectation, and set acceptance criteria.
steps.instruction: 以站址的 183 GHz 水汽輻射計或 225 GHz 傾斜輻射計做天空傾角掃描（sky dip），在數個仰角量天空亮溫並擬合 τ₀；再把擬合值與公開的大氣透射模型（例如 ALMA 所用的 ATM 模型）在同一 PWV 下的預測比較，差異應在 10% 以內，否則檢查輻射計增益校正。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成量測計畫，列出儀器、基準件或參考樣品、步驟、比較對象與允收準則，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Perform a sky dip with the site 183 GHz water-vapour radiometer or a 225 GHz tipping radiometer, measuring sky brightness at several elevations and fitting τ₀; then compare the fitted value with a public atmospheric transmission model (such as the ATM model ALMA uses) at the same PWV. Agreement should be within about 10%, otherwise check the radiometer gain calibration. Mentor task: turn this into a measurement plan listing instruments, reference artefacts or samples, procedure, comparison baseline and acceptance criteria, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 注意干擾：若用低海拔站址的 τ₀ 經驗值排程，次毫米波段（Band 9、10）會在 PWV 稍高時完全不透明，觀測資料的訊噪比遠低於預期，且校正源的流量也因透射率估錯而系統性偏低。
steps.observationEn: Watch for interference: Scheduling with opacity values from a low-altitude site makes the submillimetre bands (Band 9 and 10) fully opaque at slightly elevated PWV; the data arrive with far lower signal-to-noise than planned and the calibrator fluxes are also biased low because transmission was misestimated.
steps.failure: 驗證陷阱：只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄環境條件，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Verification traps: a single measurement, no traceable reference, or unrecorded environmental conditions make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格。
steps.checkEn: Submit the measurement plan: instruments, reference, procedure, acceptance criteria and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail decision rule.

knowledge.title: 驗證方法
knowledge.text: 以站址的 183 GHz 水汽輻射計或 225 GHz 傾斜輻射計做天空傾角掃描（sky dip），在數個仰角量天空亮溫並擬合 τ₀；再把擬合值與公開的大氣透射模型（例如 ALMA 所用的 ATM 模型）在同一 PWV 下的預測比較，差異應在 10% 以內，否則檢查輻射計增益校正。
knowledge.textEn: Perform a sky dip with the site 183 GHz water-vapour radiometer or a 225 GHz tipping radiometer, measuring sky brightness at several elevations and fitting τ₀; then compare the fitted value with a public atmospheric transmission model (such as the ATM model ALMA uses) at the same PWV. Agreement should be within about 10%, otherwise check the radiometer gain calibration.

knowledge.title: 允收與不確定度
knowledge.text: 允收準則必須在量測前訂定，並與擴充不確定度一起陳述；比較基準需可追溯。
knowledge.textEn: Acceptance criteria are fixed before measuring and stated together with expanded uncertainty; the comparison reference must be traceable.

quiz.question: 要驗證「高原站址與毫米波大氣不透明度」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "High site and millimetre-wave atmospheric opacity"?
options: 以站址的 183 GHz 水汽輻射計或 225 GHz 傾斜輻射計做天空傾角掃描（sky dip），在數個仰角量天空亮溫並擬合 τ₀。
量測時不必記錄溫度、振動與時間等條件，因為它們不會影響結果。
天線數加倍，靈敏度就恰好加倍。
optionsEn: Perform a sky dip with the site 183 GHz water-vapour radiometer or a 225 GHz tipping radiometer, measuring sky brightness at several elevations and fitting τ₀.
Temperature, vibration and timing need not be recorded because they cannot affect the result.
Doubling the number of antennas exactly doubles the sensitivity.
quiz.explanation: 以站址的 183 GHz 水汽輻射計或 225 GHz 傾斜輻射計做天空傾角掃描（sky dip），在數個仰角量天空亮溫並擬合 τ₀；再把擬合值與公開的大氣透射模型（例如 ALMA 所用的 ATM 模型）在同一 PWV 下的預測比較，差異應在 10% 以內，否則檢查輻射計增益校正。 驗證需要基準、重複性與允收準則。
quiz.explanationEn: Perform a sky dip with the site 183 GHz water-vapour radiometer or a 225 GHz tipping radiometer, measuring sky brightness at several elevations and fitting τ₀; then compare the fitted value with a public atmospheric transmission model (such as the ATM model ALMA uses) at the same PWV. Verification needs a reference, repeatability and acceptance criteria.

steps.title: 高原站址與毫米波大氣不透明度：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: High site and millimetre-wave atmospheric opacity: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「查南托高原大氣視窗」的失效原因，提出能區分原因的檢查與矯正措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure causes of “Chajnantor atmospheric window” and propose discriminating checks and corrective actions.
steps.instruction: 若用低海拔站址的 τ₀ 經驗值排程，次毫米波段（Band 9、10）會在 PWV 稍高時完全不透明，觀測資料的訊噪比遠低於預期，且校正源的流量也因透射率估錯而系統性偏低。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整個系統的性能、良率或安全。
steps.instructionEn: Scheduling with opacity values from a low-altitude site makes the submillimetre bands (Band 9 and 10) fully opaque at slightly elevated PWV; the data arrive with far lower signal-to-noise than planned and the calibrator fluxes are also biased low because transmission was misestimated. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-system performance, yield or safety.
steps.observation: 連結機制：大氣不只吸收訊號，也以自身溫度發射雜訊，因此站址同時決定訊號損失與系統雜訊的下限；這是整個陣列的第一道系統邊界。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: The atmosphere not only attenuates the signal but radiates noise at its own temperature, so the site fixes both the signal loss and the noise floor; it is the first system boundary of the array.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「只要天線夠大，站址高度對毫米波觀測影響不大。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "With big enough antennas, site altitude hardly matters at millimetre wavelengths." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，並指出哪一項量測能最快確認根因、如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement that confirms the root cause fastest, and state how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 若用低海拔站址的 τ₀ 經驗值排程，次毫米波段（Band 9、10）會在 PWV 稍高時完全不透明，觀測資料的訊噪比遠低於預期，且校正源的流量也因透射率估錯而系統性偏低。
knowledge.textEn: Scheduling with opacity values from a low-altitude site makes the submillimetre bands (Band 9 and 10) fully opaque at slightly elevated PWV; the data arrive with far lower signal-to-noise than planned and the calibrator fluxes are also biased low because transmission was misestimated.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測確認；只更換零件或放寬參數可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement; merely swapping parts or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「高原站址與毫米波大氣不透明度」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "High site and millimetre-wave atmospheric opacity" misbehaves, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 所有異常都來自操作人員失誤，系統設計不需要檢討。
若用低海拔站址的 τ₀ 經驗值排程，次毫米波段（Band 9、10）會在 PWV 稍高時完全不透明，觀測資料的訊噪比遠低於預期，且校正源的流量也因透射率估錯而系統性偏低。
基線越長影像品質一定越好，短基線只是備用。
optionsEn: Every anomaly is operator error, so the system design never needs review.
Scheduling with opacity values from a low-altitude site makes the submillimetre bands (Band 9 and 10) fully opaque at slightly elevated PWV.
Longer baselines always give better images; short baselines are just backup.
quiz.explanation: 若用低海拔站址的 τ₀ 經驗值排程，次毫米波段（Band 9、10）會在 PWV 稍高時完全不透明，觀測資料的訊噪比遠低於預期，且校正源的流量也因透射率估錯而系統性偏低。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: Scheduling with opacity values from a low-altitude site makes the submillimetre bands (Band 9 and 10) fully opaque at slightly elevated PWV; the data arrive with far lower signal-to-noise than planned and the calibrator fluxes are also biased low because transmission was misestimated. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

steps.title: 干涉成像、角解析度與可回復尺度：原理與系統邊界
steps.titleEn: Interferometric imaging, angular resolution and recoverable scales: mechanism and system boundary
steps.objective: 說明「基線向量與 uv 平面」如何決定ALMA 大型毫米及次毫米波陣列的關鍵性能，並畫出其輸入、輸出與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Baseline vectors and the uv plane” determines the key performance of “Atacama Large Millimeter/submillimeter Array”, and map its inputs, outputs and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 干涉儀把每一對天線的相關輸出視為天空亮度分佈的一個空間頻率分量（可見度），空間頻率由基線向量在垂直於視線方向的投影除以波長決定。ALMA 的角解析度由最長基線 B_max 決定，約為 λ/B_max；最大可回復的擴散結構則由最短基線 B_min 決定。50 座 12 m 天線可在 150 m 到 16 km 之間重組，12 座 7 m 天線與 4 座 12 m 全功率天線組成的 Morita 緊湊陣列補足短基線與零基線資訊，使擴散結構的總流量不致流失。 師傅任務：以方塊圖畫出能量或訊號通過「基線向量與 uv 平面」的路徑，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由環境或製造決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: An interferometer treats the correlated output of each antenna pair as one spatial-frequency component of the sky brightness (a visibility), with spatial frequency set by the baseline vector projected perpendicular to the line of sight divided by wavelength. ALMA's angular resolution is set by the longest baseline B_max, roughly λ/B_max, while the largest recoverable extended structure is set by the shortest baseline B_min. Fifty 12 m antennas can be reconfigured between 150 m and 16 km, and the Morita compact array of twelve 7 m antennas plus four 12 m total-power antennas supplies short and zero spacings so that the flux of extended emission is not lost. Mentor task: draw a block diagram of the energy or signal path through “Baseline vectors and the uv plane”, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by environment or fabrication, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：角解析度 θ ≈ λ/B_max：在 345 GHz（λ = 0.87 mm）、B_max = 16 km 時 θ ≈ 0.87×10⁻³/16000 = 5.4×10⁻⁸ rad ≈ 0.011″（11 毫角秒）；12 m 天線的主波束 θ_PB ≈ 1.13λ/D ≈ 16.9″。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Angular resolution θ ≈ λ/B_max: at 345 GHz (λ = 0.87 mm) and B_max = 16 km, θ ≈ 0.87×10⁻³/16000 = 5.4×10⁻⁸ rad ≈ 0.011″ (11 milliarcseconds); the 12 m primary beam is θ_PB ≈ 1.13λ/D ≈ 16.9″.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「基線越長影像品質一定越好，短基線只是備用。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在方塊圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "Longer baselines always give better images; short baselines are just backup." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your block diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 方塊圖標明「基線向量與 uv 平面」的輸入、輸出與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The block diagram shows inputs, outputs and boundaries of “Baseline vectors and the uv plane”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 干涉成像、角解析度與可回復尺度
knowledge.titleEn: Interferometric imaging, angular resolution and recoverable scales
knowledge.text: 干涉儀把每一對天線的相關輸出視為天空亮度分佈的一個空間頻率分量（可見度），空間頻率由基線向量在垂直於視線方向的投影除以波長決定。ALMA 的角解析度由最長基線 B_max 決定，約為 λ/B_max；最大可回復的擴散結構則由最短基線 B_min 決定。
knowledge.textEn: An interferometer treats the correlated output of each antenna pair as one spatial-frequency component of the sky brightness (a visibility), with spatial frequency set by the baseline vector projected perpendicular to the line of sight divided by wavelength. ALMA's angular resolution is set by the longest baseline B_max, roughly λ/B_max, while the largest recoverable extended structure is set by the shortest baseline B_min.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：基線越長影像品質一定越好，短基線只是備用。 正確的工程判斷必須回到機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: Longer baselines always give better images; short baselines are just backup. Sound engineering judgement goes back to mechanism and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「干涉成像、角解析度與可回復尺度」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Interferometric imaging, angular resolution and recoverable scales" is correct?
options: 基線越長影像品質一定越好，短基線只是備用。
25 µm 的面形精度對 ALMA 所有波段都綽綽有餘。
干涉儀把每一對天線的相關輸出視為天空亮度分佈的一個空間頻率分量（可見度），空間頻率由基線向量在垂直於視線方向的投影除以波長決定。
optionsEn: Longer baselines always give better images; short baselines are just backup.
A 25 µm surface is more than good enough for every ALMA band.

An interferometer treats the correlated output of each antenna pair as one spatial-frequency component of the sky brightness (a visibility), with spatial frequency set by the baseline vector projected perpendicular to the line of sight divided by wavelength.
quiz.explanation: 干涉儀把每一對天線的相關輸出視為天空亮度分佈的一個空間頻率分量（可見度），空間頻率由基線向量在垂直於視線方向的投影除以波長決定。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: An interferometer treats the correlated output of each antenna pair as one spatial-frequency component of the sky brightness (a visibility), with spatial frequency set by the baseline vector projected perpendicular to the line of sight divided by wavelength. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 干涉成像、角解析度與可回復尺度：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Interferometric imaging, angular resolution and recoverable scales: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「基線向量與 uv 平面」的關鍵量，並判斷參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Baseline vectors and the uv plane” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of changes when a parameter moves.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：角解析度 θ ≈ λ/B_max：在 345 GHz（λ = 0.87 mm）、B_max = 16 km 時 θ ≈ 0.87×10⁻³/16000 = 5.4×10⁻⁸ rad ≈ 0.011″（11 毫角秒）；12 m 天線的主波束 θ_PB ≈ 1.13λ/D ≈ 16.9″。最大可回復尺度約 0.6λ/B_min：12 m 陣列 B_min ≈ 15 m 時約 7″，7 m 陣列 B_min ≈ 9 m 時約 12″。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Angular resolution θ ≈ λ/B_max: at 345 GHz (λ = 0.87 mm) and B_max = 16 km, θ ≈ 0.87×10⁻³/16000 = 5.4×10⁻⁸ rad ≈ 0.011″ (11 milliarcseconds); the 12 m primary beam is θ_PB ≈ 1.13λ/D ≈ 16.9″. The largest recoverable scale is about 0.6λ/B_min: roughly 7″ for the 12 m array with B_min ≈ 15 m and 12″ for the 7 m array with B_min ≈ 9 m. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, and state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper.
steps.observation: 如何核對：觀測一個已知緻密的校正源（類星體）並成像，量測合成波束的半高全寬並與 λ/B_max 的預測比較；再觀測一個已知尺度的擴散源（行星或分子雲），比較僅用 12 m 陣列與加入 7 m 陣列後回復的總流量，確認短基線缺失造成的流量損失。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Image a known compact calibrator (a quasar), measure the synthesised beam FWHM and compare with the λ/B_max prediction; then observe a source of known extent (a planet or a molecular cloud), compare the total flux recovered with the 12 m array alone against 12 m plus 7 m data, and confirm the flux lost to missing short spacings.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成設備規格，或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit conversion slips, treating teaching assumptions as equipment specifications, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 重現模型中的數值（取整誤差在 ±5% 內），並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與物理解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values (within ±5% rounding) and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with a physical explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: 角解析度 θ ≈ λ/B_max：在 345 GHz（λ = 0.87 mm）、B_max = 16 km 時 θ ≈ 0.87×10⁻³/16000 = 5.4×10⁻⁸ rad ≈ 0.011″（11 毫角秒）；12 m 天線的主波束 θ_PB ≈ 1.13λ/D ≈ 16.9″。最大可回復尺度約 0.6λ/B_min：12 m 陣列 B_min ≈ 15 m 時約 7″，7 m 陣列 B_min ≈ 9 m 時約 12″。
knowledge.textEn: Angular resolution θ ≈ λ/B_max: at 345 GHz (λ = 0.87 mm) and B_max = 16 km, θ ≈ 0.87×10⁻³/16000 = 5.4×10⁻⁸ rad ≈ 0.011″ (11 milliarcseconds); the 12 m primary beam is θ_PB ≈ 1.13λ/D ≈ 16.9″. The largest recoverable scale is about 0.6λ/B_min: roughly 7″ for the 12 m array with B_min ≈ 15 m and 12″ for the 7 m array with B_min ≈ 9 m.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設；套用到實際設備前，必須重新取得規格、操作條件與不確定度。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions; before applying them to real equipment, obtain the actual specifications, operating conditions and uncertainties.

quiz.question: 依「干涉成像、角解析度與可回復尺度」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Interferometric imaging, angular resolution and recoverable scales", which statement holds?
options: 乾燥站址上的大氣相位是穩定的，只要校正一次即可。
天線數加倍，靈敏度就恰好加倍。
optionsEn: Angular resolution θ ≈ λ/B_max: at 345 GHz (λ = 0.87 mm) and B_max = 16 km, θ ≈ 0.87×10⁻³/16000 = 5.4×10⁻⁸ rad ≈ 0.011″ (11 milliarcseconds).
At a dry site the atmospheric phase is stable, so one calibration is enough.
Doubling the number of antennas exactly doubles the sensitivity.
quiz.explanation: 角解析度 θ ≈ λ/B_max：在 345 GHz（λ = 0.87 mm）、B_max = 16 km 時 θ ≈ 0.87×10⁻³/16000 = 5.4×10⁻⁸ rad ≈ 0.011″（11 毫角秒）；12 m 天線的主波束 θ_PB ≈ 1.13λ/D ≈ 16.9″。 重算時請保留單位。
quiz.explanationEn: Angular resolution θ ≈ λ/B_max: at 345 GHz (λ = 0.87 mm) and B_max = 16 km, θ ≈ 0.87×10⁻³/16000 = 5.4×10⁻⁸ rad ≈ 0.011″ (11 milliarcseconds); the 12 m primary beam is θ_PB ≈ 1.13λ/D ≈ 16.9″. Keep units when recalculating.

steps.title: 干涉成像、角解析度與可回復尺度：量測與驗證
steps.titleEn: Interferometric imaging, angular resolution and recoverable scales: measurement and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的量測，驗證「基線向量與 uv 平面」是否符合模型預期，並訂出允收準則。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable measurement that verifies whether “Baseline vectors and the uv plane” meets the model expectation, and set acceptance criteria.
steps.instruction: 觀測一個已知緻密的校正源（類星體）並成像，量測合成波束的半高全寬並與 λ/B_max 的預測比較；再觀測一個已知尺度的擴散源（行星或分子雲），比較僅用 12 m 陣列與加入 7 m 陣列後回復的總流量，確認短基線缺失造成的流量損失。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成量測計畫，列出儀器、基準件或參考樣品、步驟、比較對象與允收準則，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Image a known compact calibrator (a quasar), measure the synthesised beam FWHM and compare with the λ/B_max prediction; then observe a source of known extent (a planet or a molecular cloud), compare the total flux recovered with the 12 m array alone against 12 m plus 7 m data, and confirm the flux lost to missing short spacings. Mentor task: turn this into a measurement plan listing instruments, reference artefacts or samples, procedure, comparison baseline and acceptance criteria, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 注意干擾：只用長基線配置觀測擴散分子雲時，大於可回復尺度的結構在影像中被濾掉，出現負碗狀底座與低估的總流量；研究者若把這當成真實的空洞結構，科學結論就錯了。
steps.observationEn: Watch for interference: Observing an extended molecular cloud only in a long-baseline configuration filters out structure larger than the recoverable scale, producing a negative bowl and an underestimated total flux; a researcher who reads that as a real cavity draws the wrong scientific conclusion.
steps.failure: 驗證陷阱：只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄環境條件，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Verification traps: a single measurement, no traceable reference, or unrecorded environmental conditions make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格。
steps.checkEn: Submit the measurement plan: instruments, reference, procedure, acceptance criteria and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail decision rule.

knowledge.title: 驗證方法
knowledge.text: 觀測一個已知緻密的校正源（類星體）並成像，量測合成波束的半高全寬並與 λ/B_max 的預測比較；再觀測一個已知尺度的擴散源（行星或分子雲），比較僅用 12 m 陣列與加入 7 m 陣列後回復的總流量，確認短基線缺失造成的流量損失。
knowledge.textEn: Image a known compact calibrator (a quasar), measure the synthesised beam FWHM and compare with the λ/B_max prediction; then observe a source of known extent (a planet or a molecular cloud), compare the total flux recovered with the 12 m array alone against 12 m plus 7 m data, and confirm the flux lost to missing short spacings.

knowledge.title: 允收與不確定度
knowledge.text: 允收準則必須在量測前訂定，並與擴充不確定度一起陳述；比較基準需可追溯。
knowledge.textEn: Acceptance criteria are fixed before measuring and stated together with expanded uncertainty; the comparison reference must be traceable.

quiz.question: 要驗證「干涉成像、角解析度與可回復尺度」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Interferometric imaging, angular resolution and recoverable scales"?
options: 沿用另一台設備或另一個案例的量測結果，就可視為本系統已完成驗證。
觀測一個已知緻密的校正源（類星體）並成像，量測合成波束的半高全寬並與 λ/B_max 的預測比較。
每座天線各自通過驗收，陣列就自動可以做科學觀測。
optionsEn: Reusing results from another instrument or another case counts as verifying this system.
Image a known compact calibrator (a quasar), measure the synthesised beam FWHM and compare with the λ/B_max prediction.
If every antenna passes its own acceptance, the array is automatically ready for science.
quiz.explanation: 觀測一個已知緻密的校正源（類星體）並成像，量測合成波束的半高全寬並與 λ/B_max 的預測比較；再觀測一個已知尺度的擴散源（行星或分子雲），比較僅用 12 m 陣列與加入 7 m 陣列後回復的總流量，確認短基線缺失造成的流量損失。 驗證需要基準、重複性與允收準則。
quiz.explanationEn: Image a known compact calibrator (a quasar), measure the synthesised beam FWHM and compare with the λ/B_max prediction; then observe a source of known extent (a planet or a molecular cloud), compare the total flux recovered with the 12 m array alone against 12 m plus 7 m data, and confirm the flux lost to missing short spacings. Verification needs a reference, repeatability and acceptance criteria.

steps.title: 干涉成像、角解析度與可回復尺度：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Interferometric imaging, angular resolution and recoverable scales: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「基線向量與 uv 平面」的失效原因，提出能區分原因的檢查與矯正措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure causes of “Baseline vectors and the uv plane” and propose discriminating checks and corrective actions.

Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-system performance, yield or safety.

steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: Fifty 12 m antennas can be reconfigured between 150 m and 16 km, and the Morita compact array of twelve 7 m antennas plus four 12 m total-power antennas supplies short and zero spacings so that the flux of extended emission is not lost.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「基線越長影像品質一定越好，短基線只是備用。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "Longer baselines always give better images; short baselines are just backup." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，並指出哪一項量測能最快確認根因、如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement that confirms the root cause fastest, and state how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 只用長基線配置觀測擴散分子雲時，大於可回復尺度的結構在影像中被濾掉，出現負碗狀底座與低估的總流量；研究者若把這當成真實的空洞結構，科學結論就錯了。
knowledge.textEn: Observing an extended molecular cloud only in a long-baseline configuration filters out structure larger than the recoverable scale, producing a negative bowl and an underestimated total flux; a researcher who reads that as a real cavity draws the wrong scientific conclusion.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測確認；只更換零件或放寬參數可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement; merely swapping parts or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「干涉成像、角解析度與可回復尺度」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Interferometric imaging, angular resolution and recoverable scales" misbehaves, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 調高增益或放寬允收值，就能解決大多數異常。
25 µm 的面形精度對 ALMA 所有波段都綽綽有餘。
只用長基線配置觀測擴散分子雲時，大於可回復尺度的結構在影像中被濾掉，出現負碗狀底座與低估的總流量；研究者若把這當成真實的空洞結構，科學結論就錯了。
optionsEn: Raising the gain or widening the acceptance limits solves most anomalies.
A 25 µm surface is more than good enough for every ALMA band.
Observing an extended molecular cloud only in a long-baseline configuration filters out structure larger than the recoverable scale, producing a negative bowl and an underestimated total flux.
quiz.explanation: 只用長基線配置觀測擴散分子雲時，大於可回復尺度的結構在影像中被濾掉，出現負碗狀底座與低估的總流量；研究者若把這當成真實的空洞結構，科學結論就錯了。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: Observing an extended molecular cloud only in a long-baseline configuration filters out structure larger than the recoverable scale, producing a negative bowl and an underestimated total flux; a researcher who reads that as a real cavity draws the wrong scientific conclusion. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.
